title: theodorea glanduligera
intro: Theodorea glanduligera, commonly known as the Sandalwood, is a species of flowering plant in the family Santalaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which can help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Sandalwood include its sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-depressant properties, making it a popular ingredient in aromatherapy and traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Theodorea glanduligera include alpha-santalol, beta-santalol, and other sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and fragrance.
